nodes.name: Ni-Fe oxide nanoparticles via tea leaf templating
nodes.procedure: A series of Ni-Fe oxide nanoparticles with an average particle size of about 8 nm and similar textural parameters could be prepared using the pore confinement of the tea leaves as a template. All of the Ni-containing samples were observed to undergo an activation process during electrochemical cycling due to the Fe impurity uptake from the KOH electrolyte.

nodes.name: Co-B oxide precipitation
nodes.procedure: A series of Co-B oxides with variable morphology, crystallinity, and textural parameters were prepared by a facile precipitation method by using NaBH4 as reducing agent and B source. Treatment of as-made materials at elevated temperatures induced the formation of crystalline Co3O4 and amorphous boron oxide.
